name: Invite NetSuite contacts to be collaborators into Box folders
description:
1. A new contact is created in NetSuite.
2. If the contact has a company, Workato checks if a shared folder with the **company name** exists.
3. If the shared folder does not exist, Workato creates a new shared folder with the **company name**.
4. Workato invites the new contact to collaborate in the shared folder with a role of "Viewer/Uploader".
